command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
EXPECTED_HTML="18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e"
test "$(hostname)" = "ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein"
ACTUAL=$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
echo HTML_SHA256=$ACTUAL
test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = active
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
t=Path('buehne.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
needles=[
'kopfRollAusgleichDeg += (kopfRollWert - kopfRollAusgleichDeg) * 0.4;',
'augenOffsetDx += (zielOffset.dx - augenOffsetDx) * 0.4;',
'augenOffsetDy += (zielOffset.dy - augenOffsetDy) * 0.4;',
'kopfRollAusgleichDeg = kopfRollWert;',
'augenOffsetDx = zielOffset.dx;',
'augenOffsetDy = zielOffset.dy;',
'KOPF_ROLL_AUGEN_OFFSET'
]
for n in needles: print('COUNT',repr(n),t.count(n))
keys=['function kopfRollTick','function kopfKoerperDrehSchritt','KOPF_ROLL_AUGEN_OFFSET','kopfRollAusgleichDeg +=','augenOffsetDx +=']
for k in keys:
    i=t.find(k)
    print('===KEY',k,'POS',i,'===')
    if i>=0: print(t[max(0,i-500):min(len(t),i+1800)])
PY
echo ===FPS===
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/status | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({"fps":(d.get("fps") or {}).get("fps"),"ts":(d.get("fps") or {}).get("ts")},sort_keys=True))'
echo PROBE_SCOPE=EXACT_CURRENT_ROLL_EYE_GEOMETRY_READ_ONLY
